hints: A force into the surface does not push along the slope at all. What does it change?
worded:
1. The block alone would slide: tan 30° ≈ 0.58 exceeds μ = 0.5.

2. F, pressing into the incline, adds directly to the normal force: N = mg cos 30° + F.

3. Holding it needs μN ≥ mg sin 30° = 10 N, so N ≥ 20 N.

4. mg cos 30° = 17.3 N, so F ≥ 2.7 N. (A)
mistakes: F works only through friction: it multiplies by μ, so it is not 10 N.
